slides.title: What do Ethiopians in Moyale, Kenya need?
Food is the top need
slides.body: 71% do not have enough to eat, a rapid assessment of 758 households found.

slides.title: Water and shelter are short
slides.body: 44% lack enough drinking water. Some sleep outdoors, IOM says.

slides.title: About 50,000 have crossed
slides.body: IOM: most stay with host families. It urges urgent funding.

slides.title: Protect civilians, fund aid access
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
